blockingIssues: Resort versus settlement scope requires explicit human mapping. The existing automatic class policy does not support ski resort Q130003, and the exact catalogue label Brezovica is not the entity label Brezovica Ski Resort.
brezovica.requiredAction: Confirm the catalogue subject means the Brezovica ski-resort/mountain area, not the nearby settlement or any other Brezovica.

crete.requiredAction: Approve the exact photo, both crops and licence/credit terms. Existing registration is high-confidence constrained-name, not marked human-reviewed.

blockingIssues: The catalogue says Mavrovo without a geographic extent. Park, lake and village are different entities. Do not silently map the whole destination to the photographed reservoir or village.
mavrovo.requiredAction: Confirm whether the subject denotes Mavrovo National Park/wider nature area (proposed), Mavrovo Lake, or Mavrovo village. The photo is specifically the lake.

blockingIssues: Waterfall class Q34038 is unsupported by the existing automatic geographic-class policy. Wikidata has two distinct non-deprecated Earth coordinates; its English label Miruša Waterfalls also does not normalize to the catalogue spelling Mirusha Waterfalls. No arbitrary point/alias was added.
mirusha.requiredAction: Verify the waterfall complex Q3299918, approve the catalogue spelling/alias and select a source-backed representative coordinate (or deliberately omit optional coordinates) via human mapping.

blockingIssues: The wider region entity has an Albania P17 claim despite its Kosovo description; the official Peja source places the Rugova region northwest of Peja. The region and the photographed canyon are not interchangeable. Country was not silently overwritten.
